name: Chat loading
purpose: Shows that GOV.UK Chat is busy: Sending... while the user's question is sent, then Generating your answer…, with the app's animation, until the answer comes.

origin.notes: ChatCellView's sending and pending answer. Sending is Subheadline at the right, in place of the question, which isn't shown until it's sent. Generating is Body after a 32pt Lottie animation of a pink and a blue circle passing through each other. The Android app's Loading and Sending are the same, with the same animation.

stage.description: sending: Sending..., at the right, while the question is sent. generating: Generating your answer…, after the animation, while the answer is being written.

rules: Use sending in place of the question the user has just asked, and generating below it, as the app shows both while a question is sent.
Once the question is sent, show it with a chat question, and keep generating below it until the answer comes.
Replace it with the answer. Never leave it in a conversation that has its answer.

ios.symbol: The animation, in light mode, and _dark beside it

references.description: Sending, then generating, in light mode, caught as the screen fades in, so its background is paler than it is
